methods.name: public CompletableFuture<Integer> requestDomainSelection(@NonNull DomainSelectionService.SelectionAttributes attr, @NonNull DomainSelectionConnectionCallback callback)
methods.comment:
* Requests a domain selection for SMS.
     *
     * @param attr The attributes required to determine the domain.
     * @param callback A callback to notify an error of the domain selection.
     * @return A {@link CompletableFuture} to get the selected domain
     *         {@link NetworkRegistrationInfo#DOMAIN_PS} or
     *         {@link NetworkRegistrationInfo#DOMAIN_CS}.

methodNames: public CompletableFuture<Integer> requestDomainSelection(@NonNull DomainSelectionService.SelectionAttributes attr, @NonNull DomainSelectionConnectionCallback callback)
